I think you might mean Stare Decisis but here is the reasoning for standing.

Standing is important for a couple of reasons. The big reason is so cases are tried by people who are similar to the defendant. You wouldn't want to have your robbery case tried in California if you committed it in Arkansas. It makes it more feasible to pick a jury of your peers. The other reason is to make sure that the court with the approrpriate authority is ruling on it. Having the supreme court rules on an affray case is a bit odd and having a state court have a Treason trial misses the whole point of federalism. Basically standing is there to organize the court system and make sure everything goes where it should and is heard by the right people.
